name: game-generated-check
goal: New 2D and 3D projects and supported game generators pass their own normal project checks

evidence: Full creation includes running the generated project check, not only inspecting generated files or opening the page.
The standard game CLI scenarios now run bun run check after every supported generator, matching the existing app and library creation scenarios.

Immutable 9bc153e1 runs both normal generated game checks after GameDocumentRepository.save; both fail Prettier with [warn] game.json. The unchanged tests retain their full type, lint, unit, build and audit steps.
Generated games use the json-stringify formatter for game.json, matching the canonical tab-indented encoding used by the authoring repository; initial documents use that encoding too.
Paired 9bc153e1 red and 906f47e8 green use identical full game CLI scenarios, fixture, command and runtime profile. Both dimensions now pass their own complete checks after authoring and saving.
